    Business management shouldn't be complicated.

    Managing sales, stock, expenses and business performance across disconnected processes can make daily operations unnecessarily difficult. Notebooks, spreadsheets and separate tools make it harder to see what is really happening in the business.

    Everything working together.

    Unisale POS brings supported business operations into one platform, so a sale at the counter updates your stock and your reports without extra work.

    What you can do

    Sales Management

    Record sales at the terminal, take cash and M-Pesa payments, and open and close the register each day. Every sale produces a receipt, refunds are recorded against the original receipt, and the terminal has an offline mode that syncs when the connection returns.

    Inventory Management

    Organise products by category and brand, watch stock levels, adjust stock when counts change, raise purchase orders with suppliers, receive goods and record supplier payments.

    Expense Management

    Record cash taken out of the till for expenses and other payouts, so your cash position stays accurate.

    Financial Reporting

    Review sales performance on the dashboard and download a sales report as a PDF.

    Branch Management

    Run more than one location under one account and move stock between branches with transfers that are dispatched and received.

    Payment Integration

    Accept cash and M-Pesa payments at the sale and keep a record of every transaction.
